name: Matthew traces Jesus's genealogy from Abraham through David to Joseph
summary: Matthew opens his gospel with a genealogy in three sets of fourteen generations, tracing Jesus's ancestry from Abraham through King David down to Joseph, the husband of Mary.

name: An angel tells Joseph in a dream to take Mary as his wife
summary: When Joseph resolves to quietly divorce the pregnant Mary, an angel appears to him in a dream and tells him the child is from the Holy Spirit and to name him Jesus.

name: Magi from the east follow a star to worship the child born king
summary: Magi from the east arrive in Jerusalem asking for the child born king of the Jews, are directed by Herod's scholars to Bethlehem, and worship the child there with gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

name: Joseph flees with Mary and Jesus after being warned in a dream
summary: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes Mary and Jesus and flees by night, and the enraged Herod, unable to find the child, orders the killing of every boy two and under in the town where the magi said he was born.

name: The family returns and settles in Galilee after Herod's death
summary: After Herod dies, an angel tells Joseph it is safe to return, but fearing Herod's son who now rules Judea, Joseph settles the family in a town in Galilee instead.

name: John the Baptist preaches repentance and calls religious leaders a brood of vipers
summary: Dressed in camel's hair and eating locusts and wild honey, John the Baptist preaches that the kingdom of heaven is near and warns the Pharisees and Sadducees who come to him that lineage alone will not save them.

name: A voice from heaven declares Jesus God's beloved Son at his baptism
summary: John baptizes Jesus after initially objecting that he himself needs to be baptized by Jesus, and as Jesus comes up from the water the Spirit descends like a dove and a voice from heaven calls him God's beloved Son.

name: Jesus resists three temptations from the devil in the wilderness
summary: After fasting forty days, Jesus is tempted by the devil to turn stones to bread, to throw himself from the temple, and to worship the devil for the world's kingdoms, and answers each temptation by quoting Scripture.

name: Jesus begins preaching and calls his first four disciples
summary: Jesus begins preaching that the kingdom of heaven is near, and walking beside a lake he calls the fishermen Peter and Andrew, then James and John, who leave their nets at once to follow him.

name: Jesus teaches the Beatitudes and calls his disciples salt and light
summary: Jesus opens the Sermon on the Mount by blessing the poor in spirit, those who mourn, the meek, and those who hunger for righteousness, then tells his disciples they are the salt of the earth and the light of the world.

name: Jesus reinterprets the law on anger, adultery, oaths, and love for enemies
summary: Jesus repeatedly says "you have heard it said... but I say to you," deepening the law's demands on anger, lust, oaths, retaliation, and love, and calls his disciples to a righteousness greater than the scribes and Pharisees.

name: Jesus teaches his disciples the Lord's Prayer
summary: Jesus tells his disciples to give, pray, and fast in secret rather than to be seen by others, and gives them a model prayer beginning "Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name."

name: Jesus tells his disciples to store up treasure in heaven, not on earth
summary: Jesus warns that no one can serve both God and money, tells his disciples to store up treasure in heaven rather than on earth, and tells them not to be anxious about food or clothing since God feeds the birds and clothes the flowers.

name: Jesus warns against judging others and tells disciples to ask, seek, and knock
summary: Jesus warns against judging others while ignoring the log in one's own eye, tells his disciples that whoever asks, seeks, and knocks will receive, and gives the Golden Rule: do to others what you would have them do to you.

name: Jesus ends the sermon with the parable of the wise and foolish builders
summary: Jesus warns against false prophets who look like sheep but are ferocious wolves, then closes the sermon with the parable of the wise man who builds his house on rock and the foolish man who builds his on sand.

name: Jesus heals a leper and commends a centurion's faith
summary: Jesus heals a leper with a touch, then heals a Roman centurion's paralyzed servant from a distance, telling the crowd he has not found faith this great anywhere in Israel.

name: Jesus calms a storm and casts demons out of two men into a herd of pigs
summary: Jesus rebukes a violent storm on the lake and it becomes perfectly calm, then casts demons out of two violent men into a herd of pigs, which rush down a bank and drown.

name: Jesus forgives and heals a paralyzed man lowered through a roof
summary: When friends lower a paralyzed man to Jesus, he first forgives the man's sins, and when scribes object he heals the man's body too, to prove he has authority on earth to forgive sins.

name: Jesus calls Matthew and heals a bleeding woman and a ruler's daughter
summary: Jesus calls the tax collector Matthew to follow him and eats with tax collectors and sinners, then on the way to raise a ruler's dead daughter he heals a woman who touches his cloak after twelve years of bleeding.

name: Jesus names his twelve apostles and gives them authority to heal
summary: Jesus calls his twelve disciples together, names them the twelve apostles, and gives them authority to drive out unclean spirits and heal every disease and affliction.

name: Jesus sends the Twelve out to Israel with warnings of coming persecution
summary: Jesus sends the Twelve out to the towns of Israel, instructs them to travel without money or extra clothing, warns them they will be persecuted, and promises that whoever loses his life for his sake will find it.

name: John the Baptist sends disciples from prison to ask if Jesus is the one to come
summary: From prison, John the Baptist sends his disciples to ask Jesus if he is the one who is to come, and Jesus answers by pointing to the blind seeing, the lame walking, and the dead being raised.

name: Jesus denounces unrepentant towns and invites the weary to find rest in him
summary: Jesus denounces the Galilean towns that saw his miracles yet did not repent, then invites all who are weary and burdened to come to him, promising that his yoke is easy and his burden is light.

name: Jesus heals a man's withered hand and declares himself lord of the Sabbath
summary: After Pharisees criticize his disciples for picking grain on the Sabbath, Jesus heals a man's withered hand in the synagogue on the Sabbath and declares that the Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.

name: Accused of casting out demons by Beelzebul, Jesus points to the sign of Jonah
summary: Pharisees accuse Jesus of casting out demons by the prince of demons, and Jesus answers that a divided kingdom cannot stand, then tells the crowd that this evil generation will be given no sign except the sign of Jonah.

name: Jesus tells the parable of the sower and explains why he teaches in parables
summary: Jesus tells a large crowd the parable of a sower whose seed falls on different kinds of soil, then privately explains to his disciples why he teaches in parables and what each kind of soil represents.

name: Jesus tells several more parables describing the kingdom of heaven
summary: Jesus compares the kingdom of heaven to weeds sown among wheat, a mustard seed, leaven worked into dough, treasure hidden in a field, a pearl of great price, and a net that catches fish of every kind.

name: Jesus is rejected by the people of his hometown
summary: Jesus returns to his hometown and teaches in the synagogue, but the people take offense because they know him only as the carpenter's son, and he does few miracles there because of their unbelief.

name: Herod Antipas beheads John the Baptist to keep a rash oath
summary: Herod Antipas, who had imprisoned John the Baptist for condemning his marriage to Herodias, has him beheaded after promising Herodias's dancing daughter anything she asked and being trapped by his own oath.

name: Jesus feeds five thousand and walks on the water to his disciples
summary: Jesus feeds a crowd of five thousand men with five loaves and two fish, then later walks on the water to his disciples during a storm, and Peter briefly walks toward him before beginning to sink in fear.

name: Jesus rebukes the Pharisees for elevating tradition over God's commands
summary: When Pharisees criticize his disciples for not washing their hands before eating, Jesus rebukes them for letting human tradition override God's commands and teaches that what defiles a person comes from the heart, not unwashed hands.

name: A Canaanite woman's persistent faith moves Jesus to heal her daughter
summary: A Canaanite woman begs Jesus to heal her demon-possessed daughter, and after testing her persistence he praises her great faith and heals the girl, then feeds four thousand people with seven loaves and a few fish.
place: the region of Tyre and Sidon

name: Jesus warns his disciples against the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees
summary: Pharisees and Sadducees ask Jesus for a sign from heaven, and after refusing them he warns his disciples to be on guard against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees, which he compares to leaven.

name: Peter confesses Jesus as the Christ, who begins predicting his death
summary: At Caesarea Philippi, Peter answers Jesus's question by confessing him as the Christ, the Son of the living God, and Jesus responds by naming him the rock on which he will build his church and giving him the keys of the kingdom of heaven, then begins to tell his disciples he must suffer, die, and be raised, and rebukes Peter for objecting.

name: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John as Moses and Elijah appear
summary: Jesus leads Peter, James, and John up a mountain, where he is transfigured before them, his face shining like the sun, and Moses and Elijah appear talking with him as a cloud and voice again call him God's beloved Son.

name: Jesus heals a boy his disciples could not heal because of their little faith
summary: Coming down the mountain, Jesus heals a boy his disciples could not free from a demon, telling them their faith is too small, then predicts his death a second time and pays the temple tax with a coin from a fish's mouth.

name: Jesus calls his disciples to childlike humility and tells the parable of the lost sheep
summary: Jesus sets a child among his disciples and tells them to become like children to enter the kingdom of heaven, warns against causing a little one to sin, and tells the parable of a shepherd leaving ninety-nine sheep to find one lost.

name: Jesus tells Peter to forgive seventy-seven times and gives the parable of the unforgiving servant
summary: Jesus gives instructions for confronting a sinning church member, then answers Peter's question about forgiveness by saying seventy-seven times, not seven, and tells the parable of an unforgiving servant to illustrate why.

name: Jesus teaches on divorce and blesses the little children brought to him
summary: Pharisees test Jesus by asking about divorce, and he points back to God's original design for marriage as one flesh, then blesses the little children his disciples had tried to turn away.

name: A rich young man turns away sad rather than sell his possessions
summary: A rich young man asks Jesus what he must do to have eternal life, and goes away grieving when told to sell his possessions and give to the poor, prompting Jesus to say it is hard for the rich to enter the kingdom.

name: Jesus tells the parable of the workers who all receive the same wage
summary: Jesus tells the parable of a landowner who pays workers hired at the end of the day the same wage as those hired at dawn, illustrating that the last will be first and the first last.

name: Jesus predicts his death a third time and heals two blind men on the roadside
summary: Jesus predicts his death and resurrection a third time, answers the mother of James and John's request for her sons then tells his indignant disciples that greatness in his kingdom means serving others, and heals two blind men who cry out to him as the Son of David.

name: Jesus rides into the city on a donkey and its colt as crowds hail him
summary: Jesus sends disciples ahead for a donkey and its colt and rides in on them as crowds spread cloaks and branches on the road and shout "Hosanna to the Son of David," then drives the money changers out of the temple.

name: Jesus curses a fig tree and tells the parable of the wicked tenants
shortName: The fig tree and the tenants
summary: Jesus curses a fruitless fig tree, which withers at once, and when the religious leaders question his authority he answers with the parable of the two sons and the parable of tenants who kill the vineyard owner's son.

name: Jesus tells the parable of the wedding feast and answers a question about taxes
shortName: The wedding feast; taxes to Caesar
summary: Jesus tells the parable of a king's wedding feast that the invited guests refuse to attend, and when Pharisees try to trap him over paying taxes to Caesar he answers to give Caesar what is Caesar's and God what is God's.

name: Jesus names the greatest commandments and stumps the Pharisees about the Christ
summary: Jesus silences the Sadducees on the resurrection, tells a Pharisee that loving God and loving one's neighbor are the greatest commandments, then asks the Pharisees whose son the Christ is, and none can answer him.

name: Jesus warns the crowds against the hypocrisy of the scribes and Pharisees
summary: Jesus tells the crowds and his disciples to do what the scribes and Pharisees teach but not what they do, since they do their good works to be seen and love the places of honor.

name: Jesus pronounces seven woes on the scribes and Pharisees and laments over Jerusalem
summary: Jesus pronounces seven woes on the scribes and Pharisees for their hypocrisy, calling them whitewashed tombs, then laments over Jerusalem for killing the prophets sent to it and longs to gather its children as a hen gathers her chicks.

name: Jesus predicts the temple's destruction and describes wars and persecutions as birth pains
summary: Jesus predicts that not one stone of the temple will be left on another, and when his disciples ask for a sign he describes wars, famines, and persecutions as only the beginning of birth pains.

name: Jesus describes his coming as sudden and calls his disciples to stay watchful
shortName: Watch, for you do not know the day
summary: Jesus says the Son of Man's coming will be as visible as lightning, tells the parable of the fig tree's leaves, and warns that no one knows the day or hour, comparing it to the flood in Noah's day, so his disciples must stay watchful.

name: Jesus tells the parables of the ten virgins and the talents
summary: Jesus tells the parable of ten virgins waiting for a bridegroom, five who bring enough oil and five who do not, and the parable of a master who entrusts talents to three servants and rewards the ones who put them to use.

name: Jesus describes the final judgment separating the sheep from the goats
summary: Jesus describes the Son of Man separating all the nations like a shepherd separating sheep from goats, welcoming those who fed, clothed, and visited "the least of these" and turning away those who did not.

name: Judas agrees to betray Jesus, who institutes the Lord's Supper at Passover
summary: While chief priests plot to kill Jesus, Judas agrees to betray him for thirty pieces of silver, and Jesus shares the Passover meal with his disciples, giving them bread and wine as his body and blood.

name: Jesus prays in anguish and is betrayed and arrested
summary: Jesus prays in anguish for the cup to pass while his disciples fall asleep, then Judas arrives with an armed crowd and identifies Jesus with a kiss, and Jesus is arrested after telling Peter to put away his sword.

name: Jesus is condemned by the Sanhedrin while Peter denies him three times
summary: The Sanhedrin condemns Jesus for blasphemy after he affirms he is the Christ, while outside in the courtyard Peter denies three times that he knows Jesus before the rooster crows and he weeps bitterly.

name: Judas hangs himself, and Pilate offers the crowd a choice between Jesus and Barabbas
summary: Filled with remorse, Judas returns the silver to the chief priests and hangs himself, while Jesus stands trial before Pilate, who offers to release either Jesus or the notorious prisoner Barabbas.

name: Jesus is crucified and dies as the temple curtain tears in two
summary: The crowd chooses Barabbas over Jesus, and Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified after washing his hands of the matter; Jesus is mocked, crucified between two criminals, and dies as the temple curtain tears in two and the earth shakes.

name: Joseph of Arimathea buries Jesus in his own new tomb
summary: A rich disciple named Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus's body and lays it in his own new tomb, which the chief priests then seal and station guards at.

name: An angel announces that Jesus has risen from the empty tomb
summary: An angel descends and rolls away the tomb's stone, telling the women who came to the tomb that Jesus has risen just as he said, and the guards are later bribed to say the disciples stole the body while they slept.

name: Jesus commissions his eleven disciples to make disciples of all nations
summary: Jesus meets his eleven remaining disciples on a mountain in Galilee and commissions them to make disciples of all nations, baptizing and teaching them, promising to be with them always, to the end of the age.
